note: Buildings the PLATEAU context does not draw. A visual omission, not a data claim. Applied at load by scene/context.ts by triangle range of the GLB's own mesh; the ranges are the receipts' feature table (context-features.json) and must match it. Each range also carries the bounding box ([minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ], glTF axes, metres) of the vertices its triangles use; scene/context.ts checks it at load, so a file whose features are reordered (same triangle total, different buildings in the ranges) is refused and the procedural street is drawn. test/context.test.ts requires the stored boxes to equal the ones measured from the committed GLBs. test/context.test.ts requires this list to equal exactly the buildings whose footprint overlaps our walkable street (so it cannot grow silently), requires every id and range to exist in the features table, and requires the GLBs to be the ones named here. Refresh together with the GLBs.
